description: Free, read-only. Extract plain text from a PDF given as a URL (max 20 MB) or inline base64 (max 5 MB), one of the two. Returns text, cut at maxChars with a marker. Text-layer PDFs only: scans return little or nothing (no OCR). Layout and tables are not preserved. Fails if the URL serves HTML, not a PDF.

data.description: Base64 PDF, max 5 MB decoded. Not with url.

url.description: Direct link to the .pdf file, not a viewer page. Not with data.

name: pdf_text_extract
title: Extract PDF text
